                            2021
                 Annual Report 年報
              Samsonite International S.A.
                      新秀麗國際有限公司

                    Stock Code 股份代號 1910
OUR
RESPONSIBLE
JOURNEY
We are pleased with Samsonite’s progress in 2021. With increased vaccination
rates, easing of social-distancing measures and reopening of domestic travel in
markets around the world, our performance markedly improved. With our strong
financial position, proven discipline in controlling costs and managing cash, as well
as our highly responsive, decentralized management structure, we are confident
in our ability to navigate the ongoing challenges and where appropriate, invest for
long-term growth and shareholder value creation.

我們對新秀麗於2021年取得的進展感到欣慰。隨着全球各地疫苗接種率上升、社交距
離措施放寬以及國內旅遊重啟，我們的業績明顯改善。憑藉我們雄厚的財務狀況、對
成本和現金行之有效的嚴格管控，以及我們應對迅速的分權管理結構，我們有信心應
付接踵而來的挑戰，並適時作出投資，以實現長遠增長及創造股東價值。




Timothy Charles Parker
Chairman 主席

公司簡介

With a heritage dating back more than 110 years, Samsonite                     新秀麗國際有限公司（「本公司」，連同其綜合
International S.A. (the “Company”), together with its consolidated             附 屬 公 司 統 稱 為「 本 集 團 」）是 全 球 時 尚 箱 包
subsidiaries (the “Group”), is a leader in the global lifestyle bag industry   行業的翹楚，並且是全球最著名、規模最大
and is the world’s best-known and largest travel luggage company.              的行李箱公司，擁有逾110 年悠久歷史。本
The Group is principally engaged in the design, manufacture, sourcing          集團主要在全球從事設計、製造、採購及分
and distribution of luggage, business and computer bags, outdoor and           銷行李箱、商務包及電腦包、戶外包及休閒
casual bags and travel accessories throughout the world, primarily             包以及旅遊配件，旗下經營的品牌主要包括
under the Samsonite ®, Tumi ®, American Tourister ®, Gregory ®, High           新秀麗 ® 、T u m i ® 、A m e r i c a n T o u r i s t e r ® 、
Sierra ®, Kamiliant ®, ebags ®, Lipault ® and Hartmann ® brand names as        G r e g o r y ® 、H i g h S i e r r a ® 、K a m i l i a n t ® 、
well as other owned and licensed brand names.                                  ebags ®、Lipault ® 及Hartmann ® 品牌以及其他
                                                                               自有及獲授權的品牌。


The Company’s Strategy                                                         本公司的策略
The Company aims to increase shareholder value through sustainable             本公司旨在透過可持續收益及盈利增長以及產

to achieve this objective, the Company has adopted the following               標，本公司已採納以下主要策略：
principal strategies:


•   Ensure the Company’s well-diversified family of brands attracts            • 確保本公司的多元化品牌組合吸引旅遊及
    consumers at all price points in both the travel and non-travel                 非旅遊行李箱、箱包及配件類別所有價格
    luggage, bag and accessories categories.                                        點的消費者。

    consumer e-commerce channel.                                                    佔銷售淨額的比重。


•   Focused investment in marketing to support the Company’s                   • 於營銷方面作出重點投資，以支持本公司
    brands and initiatives.                                                         的品牌及發展方案。


•   Continue to leverage the Company’s regional management                     • 繼續憑藉本公司的地區管理架構、分銷專
    structure, distribution expertise and marketing engine to extend                長以及營銷動力，將其品牌拓展至新市
    its brands into new markets and penetrate deeper into existing                  場，並加深滲透現有渠道。
    channels.


•   Continue to invest in research and development to develop lighter          • 繼續投資於研究與開發，以開發更輕巧及
    and stronger new materials, advanced manufacturing processes,                   更堅固的新物料、先進的製造技術、具吸
    exciting new designs and sustainable collections, as well as                    引力的新設計及可持續產品系列，以及為
    innovative functionalities that deliver real benefits to consumers.             消費者帶來實際效益的創新功能。


•   Continue to incorporate the Company’s environmental, social and            • 繼續在本公司的核心業務中貫徹其環境、
    governance (“ESG”) philosophy into its core business practices                  社會及管治（「環境、社會及管治」）理念，
    through “Our Responsible Journey” to lead the industry in                       落實本公司「負責任之旅」長遠策略，引領
    sustainability and treat all stakeholders with fairness and respect in          行業可持續發展，並恪守本公司一直以來
    line with the Company’s long-standing guiding principle, “Do unto             「己所不欲，勿施於人」的指導原則，繼續
    others as you would have them do unto you”.                                     公平對待及尊重所有持份者。

MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS
管理層討論與分析


The positive quarterly trend during 2021 continued the recovery
that began in the second half of 2020. During the fourth quarter
of 2020, the Group’s net sales decreased by 57.6% (-58.1%
constant currency), year-on-year, as more of the Group’s markets
reopened. The Group’s net sales decreased by 64.6% (-64.7%
constant currency) year-on-year during the third quarter of 2020, as
governments began loosening restrictions and certain of the Group’s
markets began reopening. During the second quarter of 2020, when
most of the Group’s markets were significantly affected by the
COVID-19 Impacts, net sales decreased by 78.2% (-77.9% constant
currency) year-on-year.


The rise in new COVID-19 cases related to the Omicron variant and
the resulting reinstatement of travel restrictions and social distancing
measures in certain markets, particularly in Asia, temporarily
slowed the Group’s net sales recovery in January 2022, but sales
performance improved in February 2022. When excluding the net sales
of Speck for January and February 2019, the decline in the Group’s
net sales for the first two months of 2022 compared to the same
period in 2019 was about in line with the 28.8% (-28.0% constant
currency) decline in the fourth quarter of 2021 when compared to the       2021 年的利好季度趨勢延續了自2020 年下半

 Notes 註釋
 (1) The geographic location of the Group’s net sales generally reflects the country from which its products were sold and does not necessarily
     indicate the country in which its end consumers were actually located.
     本集團銷售淨額的地域位置分佈一般反映出售產品的國家，並不一定為終端消費者實際所在的國家。
 (2) Net sales in Belgium were US$10.1 million and US$6.7 million for the years ended December 31, 2021 and December 31, 2020,
     respectively, an increase of US$3.5 million, or 51.9% (+47.1% constant currency). Remaining sales consisted of direct shipments to
     distributors, customers and agents in other European countries, including e-commerce.
     截至2021年12月31日及2020年12月31日止年度，比利時的銷售淨額分別為10.1百萬美元及6.7百萬美元，增加3.5百萬美元或51.9%（按不變
     匯率基準計算則增加47.1%）。餘下的銷售額包括直接發貨予歐洲其他國家的分銷商、客戶及代理商（包括電子商貿）。
 (3) Net sales reported for the United Kingdom include net sales made in Ireland.
     英國錄得的銷售淨額包括於愛爾蘭錄得的銷售淨額。
 (4) Results stated on a constant currency basis, a non-IFRS measure, are calculated by applying the average exchange rate of the year under
     comparison to current year local currency results.
     按不變匯率基準計算呈列的業績為非IFRS財務計量工具，是以當地貨幣呈列的本年度業績採用與其相比較年度的平均匯率計算所得。

Cost of Sales and Gross Profit
Cost of sales increased by US$88.9 million, or 10.7%, to US$919.3
million (representing 45.5% of net sales) for the year ended December
31, 2021 from US$830.4 million (representing 54.0% of net sales) for
the year ended December 31, 2020. The Group’s gross profit was
negatively impacted by an increase in global freight and raw material
costs. The Group has leveraged its long-standing relationships with
suppliers to mitigate the effects of cost increases where possible
and has implemented price increases in certain markets to offset the
resulting margin pressure.

Gross profit increased by US$395.2 million, or 56.0%, to US$1,101.5
million for the year ended December 31, 2021 from US$706.3 million
for the year ended December 31, 2020 due to increased sales year
over year. Gross profit margin increased to 54.5% for the year ended
December 31, 2021 from 46.0% for the previous year. The increase
in gross profit margin was attributable to (i) price increases on the

Corporate Governance Practices                                             企業管治常規
The Company is committed to maintaining high standards of                  本公司致力維持高水準的企業管治。本公司認
corporate governance. The Company recognizes that sound corporate          為健全的企業管治常規是本公司能有效及具透

Principal Risks                                                            主要風險
The Company recognizes that effective management of risk is                本公司認同有效管理風險對執行本公司策略、
essential to executing the Company’s strategies, achieving sustainable     實現可持續的股東價值、保障本集團品牌及確
shareholder value, protecting the Group’s brands and ensuring good         保良好企業管治而言乃屬必要。因此，風險管
corporate governance. Accordingly, rather than being a separate            理已融入本公司的業務流程（包括策略發展、
and standalone process, risk management is integrated into the             業務規劃、資金分配、投資決策、內部控制及
Company’s business processes including strategy development,               日常營運）中，而並非作為一個分開及獨立的
business planning, capital allocation, investment decisions, internal      流程。
control and day-to-day operations.


The Board is responsible for evaluating and determining the nature         董事會負責評估及釐定其為達致本公司策略目
and extent of the risks it is willing to take in achieving the Company’s   標而願意承受的風險的性質及程度。本公司旨
strategic objectives. The Company aims to only take reasonable risks       在僅承擔(a)符合其策略、(b)可理解及管理及(c)
that (a) fit its strategy, (b) can be understood and managed, and (c) do   不會令本公司遭受以下事項的合理風險：
not expose the Company to:


•   Material financial loss impacting the ability to execute the           • 影響執行本公司業務策略的能力或嚴重損
    Company’s business strategy or materially compromising the               害本公司財政穩健性的重大財務虧損；
    Company’s financial viability;
•   Material interruption to the Company’s business;                       • 嚴重妨礙本公司業務；
•   Breaches of applicable laws and regulations; or                        • 違反適用法律及法規；或
•   Damage to the Company’s reputation and brands.                         • 損害本公司聲譽及品牌。

the extent certain pre-established cumulative performance targets                             集團或持續向本集團提供服務。並非按市況標
are met. Expense related to PRSUs with non-market performance                                 準授出的績效掛鈎受限制股份單位的相關開支
criteria is recognized ratably over the performance period, net of                            在績效期內基於達到相關表現目標的概率按比
estimated forfeitures, based on the probability of attainment of the                          例確認，並已扣除估計已沒收績效掛鈎受限制
related performance targets. The potential number of shares that                              股份單位的開支。於績效掛鈎受限制股份單位

of performance is not attained, to up to 200% of the target number of                         到最低表現要求）至績效掛鈎受限制股份單位
shares subject to the PRSUs, if the level of performance is at or above                       所涉目標股份數目的200%（倘達到或超過預先
the predetermined maximum achievement level. For PRSUs subject to                             確定的最高表現要求）。與市況相關的績效掛
market conditions, the expense is recognized over the vesting period                          鈎受限制股份單位的開支於歸屬期內確認，並
based on the fair value as determined on the grant date utilizing a                           按授出日採用蒙特卡羅模擬方法釐定的公允價
Monte Carlo simulation.                                                                       值計算。

Qualitative and Quantitative Market Risks                                 定性及定量市場風險

3.     Summary of Significant Accounting Policies                               3.     主要會計政策概要
(a)    Significant Accounting Policies                                          (a)    主要會計政策
       Unless otherwise noted, the accounting policies set out below have              除另有註明外，本集團已於此等綜合財
       been applied consistently by the Group to all periods presented,                務報表所呈列的所有期間貫徹應用下文
       where material, in these consolidated financial statements.                     載列的會計政策（倘屬重大）。


(b)    Principles of Consolidation                                              (b)    綜合原則
(i)    Subsidiaries                                                             (i)    附屬公司
       Subsidiaries are entities controlled by the Group. The Group                    附屬公司指受本集團控制的實體。當本
       controls an entity when it is exposed to, or has rights to, variable            集團承受或享有自參與實體營運而取
       returns from its involvement with the entity and has the ability to             得的可變回報，並能藉着對實體施加權
       affect those returns through its power over the entity.                         力而影響該等回報時，則本集團控制該
                                                                                       實體。


       The financial information of subsidiaries is included in the                    附屬公司的財務資料自控制開始當日起
       consolidated financial statements from the date on which control                計入綜合財務報表，直至控制終止當日
       commences until the date on which control ceases. All significant               為止。所有公司間重大結餘及交易已於
       inter-company balances and transactions have been eliminated in                 綜合入賬時抵銷。
       consolidation.


(ii)   Non-controlling Interests                                                (ii)   非控股權益
       Non-controlling interests are presented in the consolidated                     非控股權益乃於綜合財務狀況表中在權

      generally and usually meet the definition of a lease modification                優惠通常符合租賃修訂的定義及後續的
      and consequential accounting. The IASB has issued amendments                     會計處理。IASB已頒佈IFRS第16 號的
      to IFRS 16 to simplify how lessees account for rent concessions.                 修訂，以簡化承租人核算租金優惠的方
      The amendment became effective for annual reporting periods                      式。該修訂已於2020年6月1日或之後開
      beginning on or after June 1, 2020 with earlier application                      始的年度報告期間生效，並可提早應用。
      permitted.

      The amendments provide an optional practical expedient for                       該等修訂為承租人提供可選的實際權宜
      lessees in accounting for eligible rent concessions that are a direct            之計，可用於核算由2019冠狀病毒疫症
      consequence of COVID-19. Under the practical expedient, lessees                  直接產生的合資格租金優惠。根據實際
      are not required to assess whether eligible rent concessions are                 的權宜之計，承租人無須評估合資格租
      lease modifications, and instead are permitted to account for them               金優惠是否為租賃修訂，而是允許將其
      as if they were not lease modifications.                                         視為非租賃修訂進行核算。

(d)   Exposure to Market Risk                                                  (d)    所承擔的市場風險
      Market risk is the risk that changes in market prices, such as foreign          市場風險為市場價格的變動風險，如影
      exchange rates, interest rates and equity prices will affect the                響本集團的收入或其持有金融工具價值
      Group’s income or the value of its holdings of financial instruments.           的匯率、利率及股權價格。市場風險管
      The objective of market risk management is to manage and                        理的目標為管理及控制市場風險程度於
      control market risk exposures within acceptable parameters, while               可接受參數之內，同時優化回報。
      optimizing the return.


      The Group periodically buys and sells financial derivatives, such               為管理市場風險，本集團定期購買及出
      as forward purchase contracts for hedging purposes, in order to                 售金融衍生工具，例如就對沖訂立的遠
      manage market risks.                                                            期購買合約。


(i)   Currency Risk                                                            (i)    貨幣風險
      The Group is exposed to currency risk on purchases and                          本集團就以本集團附屬公司各自的功能
      borrowings that are denominated in a currency other than the                    貨幣以外的貨幣結算的採購和借款承受
      respective functional currencies of the Group’s subsidiaries.                   貨幣風險。


      The Group periodically uses forward exchange contracts to hedge                 本集團定期使用遠期外匯合約對沖其以
      its exposure to currency risk on product purchases denominated                  本集團附屬公司各自的功能貨幣以外的
      in a currency other than the respective functional currency of the              貨幣結算的產品採購的貨幣風險。該等
      Group’s subsidiaries. The forward exchange contracts typically                  遠期外匯合約的到期日一般少於一年。
      have maturities of less than one year.


      Interest on borrowings is typically denominated in the local currency           借款的利息一般以借款的當地貨幣結
      of the borrowing. Borrowings are generally denominated in                       算。借款一般以配合借款實體的相關營
      currencies that match the cash flows generated by the underlying                運產生的現金流量的貨幣計值。
      operations of the borrowing entity.

(g)   Fair Value of Financial Instruments                                       (g)   金融工具之公允價值
      Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset or              公允價值是於計量日市場參與者於有秩
      paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between market           序交易中出售資產可收取或轉讓負債須
      participants at the measurement date. IFRS establishes a fair value             支付的價格。IFRS建立一套公允價值等
      hierarchy that prioritizes the inputs to valuation techniques used              級架構，該架構排列用以計量公允價值
      to measure fair value. The hierarchy gives the highest priority to              的估值方法輸入數據的優先等級。該等
      unadjusted quoted prices in active markets for identical assets                 級架構給予於活躍市場中相同資產或負
      or liabilities (Level 1 measurements) and the lowest priority to                債的未經調整報價最高等級（第一級別計
      measurements involving significant unobservable inputs (Level 3                 量），以及涉及重大不可觀察輸入數據的
      measurements). The three levels of the fair value hierarchy are as              計量最低等級（第三級別計量）。公允價
      follows:                                                                        值等級架構的三個級別如下：

      •        Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active                •     第一級別輸入數據為本集團有能
               markets for identical assets or liabilities that the Group has               力於計量日取得的相同資產或負
               the ability to access at the measurement date.                               債於活躍市場的報價（未經調整）
                                                                                                          。
      •        Level 2 inputs are inputs other than quoted prices included            •     第二級別輸入數據為不包括第一
               within Level 1 that are observable for the asset or liability,               級別的報價的資產或負債的可直
               either directly or indirectly.                                               接或間接觀察的輸入數據。
      •        Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or                •     第三級別輸入數據為資產或負債
               liability.                                                                   的不可觀察輸入數據。

      The level in the fair value hierarchy within which a fair value                 公允價值計量整體在公允價值等級架構
      measurement in its entirety falls is based on the lowest level input            中的層級分類，乃基於對公允價值計量
      that is significant to the fair value measurement in its entirety.              整體而言屬重大的最低層級輸入數據。
